note: Glaze 1.0.39: one simple flow. Tap a theme and answer Use this theme? It goes on your widgets with its own Artwork 1-5 straight away and your icons are ready, then a short list of next steps: Add the wallpaper, View icons and View widgets. View widgets opens the Widgets tab showing the theme's artworks. Live widget pickers (clocks, countdown, battery and so on) are hidden for now. A slot never shows the same artwork twice (a calm design in the theme's colours until new art arrives), and each artwork has Save to Photos and Add to Custom 1-5.
